title: Contact — Citadel CX
description: Get in touch with Citadel CX about support delivery, security architecture, or working together.
headline: Tell us what your support looks like today.
standfirst: Whether you are handling it yourself, weighing a first hire, or already outsourcing and unhappy with it, we would like to hear about it. No deck, no pitch, just a conversation.
helpBody: None of it is required, but it helps us give you a straight answer rather than a sales call.

help.title: Roughly how much volume
help.body: Contacts per week, and whether that is email, chat, phone or a mix.

help.title: What you run today
help.body: The helpdesk or shared inbox your team works in, if you have one.

help.title: What is going wrong
help.body: Response times, cover outside hours, quality, cost — whichever it is.

help.title: Any requirements
help.body: Compliance obligations or security review processes we should know about.
